title: Lānaʻi water management area designation
summary: The state Commission on Water Resource Management planned a December 16 meeting on making Lānaʻi a water management area, which the Lānaʻi Planning Commission chair said would put that commission, not the Lānaʻi water company, in charge of the island's water. The chair said the water commission was supposed to revisit the issue on Lānaʻi every October, and he asked for a water workshop for commissioners.

timeline.text: The chair said the meeting is currently scheduled as a Zoom meeting.
